frozen_note: written on 2026-10-24 after a coverage probe (units per season, minutes between the odds snapshot and tipoff, availability of the BetsAPI game environment) and before any model-versus-market number of this model was computed. The v1 versus market result (nba_props_vs_market_protocol.json) is known and motivates the question; it is reproduced as an invariant, not re-selected
question: Does a market-anchored residual model add calibrated information to the US books' no-vig consensus for points, rebounds, assists and threes, once availability, game environment and rest are available as of the quote? Research only: it never produces a bet, a stake or a pick, promotes nothing, and capturing data does not retrain anything.

units.source: nba.props_link output (The Odds API historical per-event, region us, one snapshot per game) turned into (game, player, market, line) units by nba.props_market.units: consensus no-vig over probability = mean logit of the books, DNP and zero-minute players excluded, pushes dropped, two-sided prices only
universe_filters: the game exists in the extended box games (nba_extended_box_20261024) and in the v1.3 data (RUN071)

0 < minutes_to_tipoff <= 60: the quote must be after the T-60 injury-report cutoff, otherwise a report could carry information the price did not have (about 1.6k units of 2025-26 are earlier and are dropped and counted)
the player has at least 10 earlier box rows inside the v1 window (as in nba.props_market)
the game has a BetsAPI spread and total snapshot at or before the quote time (as-of rule below); units without are dropped and counted
units.all_lines_primary: every quoted line of a (game, player, market) is a unit, as in the v1 comparison; the main line (most books, ties to the smaller line) is a secondary subset

features.anchor: lk = logit of the consensus no-vig probability (offset with coefficient b, prior 1)
features.model_delta: logit(v1 model probability at the quoted line) - lk; v1 is nba.multimarket player model with empirical weight 0.25, window 20, minimum history 10, unchanged

availability.own_questionable_or_doubtful: 1 if the official report lists the player Questionable or Doubtful
availability.teammates_missing_minutes: sum over listed teammates of (trailing mean minutes) x (1 - participation rate of their status) / 48, exactly the v1.3 feature (nba.multimarket_v13.player_features)
availability.reports: old reports plus the T-60 backfill (the v1.5 candidate arm); a report counts only if stamped at least 60 minutes before tipoff
availability.participation_table: Beta(1,1)-smoothed participation rate by status over games of the seasons strictly before the unit's season

environment.total_c: (BetsAPI full-game total line as of the quote - mean closing total of all earlier games) / 10
environment.own_spread: the player's team full-game spread as of the quote (negative = favourite) / 10, from the BetsAPI home line, sign changed for the away team
environment.home: 1 if the player's team is the home team
environment.back_to_back: 1 if the player's team played the previous calendar day (Eastern)
environment.pace_c: (own team + opponent) / 2 mean estimated possessions of their last 10 games before the date, minus the mean of all earlier games, / 10
environment.opp_def_c: opponent points allowed per estimated possession over their last 10 games before the date, minus the mean of all earlier games, x 10
environment.min10: mean minutes of the player's last 10 participations before the date / 48

features.as_of: every feature uses only information stamped before the quote: box rows and team games from earlier dates only (same-day games excluded), injury reports at least 60 minutes before tipoff, and the latest BetsAPI snapshot whose seconds_before_tip is >= minutes_to_tipoff x 60. Closing BetsAPI lines are used only for the expanding league mean of earlier games
never_used: the realised stat or minutes of the game
the closing line of the game itself
any bookmaker price of the same prop other than through lk

model.form: per market: logit p = a + b*lk + theta . x, with x standardised on the training units; ridge penalty lambda * ||w - prior||^2 on the mean log loss, prior a = 0, b = 1, theta = 0
model.lambda_choice: 5 contiguous date blocks inside 2024-25, held-out log loss, one lambda per arm and market
model.fit: on all 2024-25 units, applied unchanged to 2025-26 (no refit on 2025-26 in the primary result)
model.walk_forward_secondary: arm E refit monthly: for each calendar month of 2025-26, train on 2024-25 plus the 2025-26 units dated before that month, same lambda, predict the month; pooled over the season

scores: calibration slope and intercept (y on logit p) on the test season
metrics.difference: paired Brier difference arm - raw market, mean over units, with a bootstrap resampling whole dates (400 replicates, seed 20261025)

controls.placebo_permutation: arm E is refit and evaluated after permuting the availability and environment columns among units of the same date and market (seed 20261025); it must not show an improvement whose upper bound is below 0, otherwise the pipeline leaks and the run is void
controls.reproduction_invariant: on the unfiltered priced units the 2025-26 paired Brier difference of v1 against the market must equal the published props_market_comparison.json value to 1e-9 for every market, otherwise the run aborts
controls.row_alignment: all arms are scored on the identical unit set

decision_rule.adds_information: per market: the upper bound of the 98.75% interval of (E - raw market) Brier on 2025-26 is below 0 AND the walk-forward pooled Brier of E is below the raw market's AND the test calibration slope of E is in [0.9, 1.1]
decision_rule.calibration_only: E beats the market but E - A_recalibration has an interval that includes 0: the gain is calibration of the market, not new information
decision_rule.otherwise: no evidence that the model adds information for that stat; the market remains the reference and this is a valid result
decision_rule.scope: necessary, not sufficient, for any use; it says nothing about prices a customer can get, limits, alternative lines or Pinnacle. Single early snapshot, US books only. No economic claim is made

outputs.report: props_residual_report.json (all arms, intervals, strata, placebo, walk-forward, drops)
outputs.coefficients: props_residual_coefficients.json per market: arm E weights and lambda, promoted false
outputs.forward_test: the same fitted E is to be scored, unchanged, on the PropLine archive as it accumulates (consensus of the six US books present on both sides, Pinnacle as a separate series); not part of this run
